entries.lead: Opt-in host lock for the CLI
entries.text: Set host_lock: true in ~/.benchbox/config.yaml, or BENCHBOX_HOST_LOCK=1, and benchbox run, run-official, datagen, convert, compare (when it runs queries) and compare-dataframes take the host lock, pass admission and run under the memory/disk watchdog. Default off; dry runs and read-only commands never lock.
